scenario.name: Test: mysql (Debian 10)
scenario.author: Thomas Shaw
scenario.description: Single-VM test scenario for the mysql service on Debian 10 (Buster, MariaDB 10.3), used to exercise the module's secgen_test via the Proxmox QEMU Guest Agent testing pipeline. The module is built on its own: security_shepherd rewrites /etc/mysql/my.cnf and sets a root password, so building mysql through it tests that module's changes, not mysql's.
